sourceProvenance.workingTreeNote: Benchmark-only horizon instrumentation is copied into the pinned replay-envelope worktree; matchmaking implementation files remain at the recorded policy commit.

metric.formula: Per player: (3C + 2O + P) / the total weight of meaningful facets; C/O/P are capped unique feasible peers divided by min(feasible peers, 13/12/6).
metric.opportunityScope: Full structural roster opportunity sets; availability, active status, player history, and balance are not filters.
metric.emptyFacetRule: Exclude empty facets and renormalize the remaining per-player weights.
metric.historyRule: Completed matches only; active assignments and reservations are excluded from the score.
